components.name: AppShell
components.purpose: Owns responsive panel composition; never project semantics.

components.name: ScrubbableNumber
components.purpose: Pointer/Pencil scrubbing with exact entry fallback.

components.name: ParameterSlider
components.purpose: Relative continuous parameter plus numeric value.

components.name: ABCompare
components.purpose: Temporary audition override with Apply B.

components.name: GeneratedClip
components.purpose: Projection of live generator; not directly mutable.

components.name: OperatorNode
components.purpose: Versioned operator projection with typed ports.

components.name: NodePalette
components.purpose: Search/add operator by concept and type.

components.name: MathCanvas
components.purpose: Lab-specific mathematical projection and direct manipulation.

components.name: PenroseTilingCanvas
components.purpose: Validated exact tiling/traversal after research gate.

components.name: MaterialStateBadge
components.purpose: Combines MaterialKind and derived SourceStatus without flattening them into one enum.

components.name: DerivationStatus
components.purpose: Shows preview/evaluation/current/cache-only/stale/error/cancelled state with text and non-color cues.

components.name: EvidenceBadge
components.purpose: Declares established, inferred, engineering-default, experimental, or research-gated claims.

components.name: ParameterEditor
components.purpose: Type-aware direct manipulation, exact entry, units, nudge, reset, wrap/clamp/reject, and accessible actions from one ParameterSpec.

components.name: MappingPipeline
components.purpose: Displays explicit source→sample→normalize→smooth→transform→quantize→constrain→target stages and causal/frozen status.

components.name: WhyThisEvent
components.purpose: Shows source value, every stage, random decision, constraint delta, final target, and evidence/diagnostic context.

components.name: TypedConnectionPreview
components.purpose: Uses compiler compatibility to preview valid targets and structured reasons before commit.

components.name: GeneratedEditChoice
components.purpose: Routes generated edits to generator, downstream exception/operator, fork, or materialization.

components.name: AudioRuntimeStatus
components.purpose: Communicates enable/arming/generation cutover/interruption/reconfiguration/error/panic without implying project mutation.

components.name: GeometryCompletenessStatus
components.purpose: Shows core/halo completeness, truncation, synthetic clip boundaries, and validation scope.
